g.text: Without an egocentric graft, linear probes read the current cell's own walls well (N, S = 0.86-0.89 after block 6) and walls

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: 1-2 cells away only weakly (0.62-0.76); at the input, readability is fully explained by the cell + step location prior (+ raw graft bits)

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: DOWN connection of the cell at offset (dr, dc); boxed = current cell, so (0,0) is its S wall and (-1,0) its N wall. RIGHT connections are the transpose (max |diff| 0.022). Mean of seeds then grids 5-10.
